title: Weekday of a future calendar date
rationale: Scheduling and deadline calculations depend on correct weekday mapping; a wrong weekday silently books meetings and deliveries on the wrong day.

prompt.content: You are a precise calendar assistant. Reason carefully, then end with exactly one final line of the form `FINAL: <weekday>`.
What day of the week is 2027-03-15? End your reply with exactly one line `FINAL: <weekday>`.

notes: Expected weekday Monday, verified with Python: datetime.date(2027, 3, 15).strftime('%A') == 'Monday'. Deterministic: static prompt and a fixed Gregorian date. Brittleness: only the FINAL line is graded, so a correct answer without the required final line fails by design.
